name: agent-workflow
description: Reusable workflow-kernel skills for Codex: deep thinking, incremental and architecture planning, implementation scoping, micro-decision locking, assumption checks, code and artifact review, delegated review-and-patch, before/after comparison, postmortems, prompt orchestration, handoffs, reorientation, and repository context.

interface.longDescription: Agent Workflow packages reusable Codex skills for deep reasoning, incremental and architecture planning, implementation scoping, micro-decision locking before bounded implementation, pre-build assumption checks, success-signal implementation, source-backed code and artifact review, delegated review-and-patch, before/after comparison, postmortem review, prompt orchestration, cold handoffs, state reorientation, and repository context. The bundled workflows preserve local repository authority and keep advisory guidance separate from strict validation, readiness, deployment, and resolver claims.
defaultPrompt: Deep think through this implementation plan
What is the highest-compounding next step?
Plan target architecture before feature planning
Scope implementation for the accepted plan
Lock micro-decisions before implementing this bounded patch
Check this plan's assumptions before we build
Compare this plan against the original intent
Reorient me on the current workflow state
Hand off this work to a fresh thread
